subject.title: feat(sessions): add local timezone prefix to archive filenames

question: Should OpenClaw make reset/delete archive filenames a `agents.defaults.userTimezone` surface using the local-date-prefix plus UTC-suffix contract proposed here?
rationale: This changes a persisted user-visible archive basename contract, and repository policy treats config-driven persisted/default behavior as compatibility-sensitive maintainer intent rather than a purely mechanical code choice.

options.title: Accept prefix after full coverage
options.body: Approve the local-date-prefix plus UTC-suffix contract, but require QMD/memory consumer coverage and real reset/delete proof before merge.

options.title: Choose another archive surface
options.body: Use a separate display/search metadata surface instead of changing persisted archive basenames, preserving the current UTC filename contract.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the linked feature issue open while maintainers decide whether archive filenames should be timezone-aware at all.

recommendation.title: Accept prefix after full coverage
recommendation.body: Approve the local-date-prefix plus UTC-suffix contract, but require QMD/memory consumer coverage and real reset/delete proof before merge.
